## Change and reason

Describe the outcome. Link the issue when applicable.

## Verification

Commands/results and limits. Explain a skipped build when relevant.

## Review

Self-review completed. For sensitive changes or new dependencies, link the independent
AI review and resolved findings for the final candidate. Remove irrelevant guidance.

## Knowledge and verification

For engine-dependent code, crash analysis or map checks: state the matching build/architecture, knowledge revision and relevant finding/rule IDs, what evidence was consulted, coverage gaps and verification level. Keep raw evidence and private paths local. If unrelated to game behavior, state why knowledge use is not applicable.

List focused tests/observations and material limits. Distinguish static/synthetic results from runtime load, gameplay and save/reopen evidence.

## Publication

Confirm no private game corpus, assets, snapshots, diagnostics or local inventories are included.
For corpus-related work, confirm published tools, tests and explanations are reviewed original work.
